name: zdeclient_apply_feature_entry
description: zDEClient::ApplyFeatureEntry clears feature runtime state for reload entries and dispatches crater or quicksand entries to their feature instancing paths.
known_limits: The smoke target covers the reload branch that clears display nodes, feature entries, and the feature map tree; crater and quicksand dispatch bodies are covered through accepted InstanceEvent/InstanceEventMaybeRelay targets.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient feature serialization/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x457c10 validates reading reloadFlag at +0x30, calling ClearFeatureDisplayNodes and ClearFeatureEntriesAndMapTree when it is nonzero, otherwise dispatching featureType 1 to zDEClient_Crater::InstanceEvent with playEffectAnim 0, featureType 3 to zDEClient_QSand::InstanceEventMaybeRelay, and returning for other types.
The native ApplyFeatureEntry reload smoke verifies a reload entry clears the feature list and resets the feature map tree through the production helper path.
